name: a model question 'Silmemi ister misin?' always has a pending delete behind it
incident: Live failure of 2026-11-19 (ADR 0011, invariant I10): the owner asked whether the laundry was removed from Thursday; the bot answered in prose 'Silmemi ister misin?' but stored no pending action, so 'evet' got 'Onay bekleyen bir islem yok'. The question must come with a pending delete preview.

model_intent.question: Perşembe (19 Kasım) günündeki "İkinci çamaşır turu" etkinliği hâlâ duruyor. Silmemi ister misin?
